VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are set to be sent to the International Space Station for astronaut training, marking a collaboration between Meta and the ESA.

VR.title: James Cameron’s 3D Studio Acquires 3D Camera Maker STEREOTEC
VR.summary: James Cameron’s Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC to enhance its production capabilities for immersive content.

VR.title: Trombone Champ: Unflattened & Maskmaker Coming To Meta Horizon+ This Month
VR.summary: Meta Horizon+ will feature new games this month, including Trombone Champ: Unflattened and Maskmaker, expanding its subscription offerings.

VR.title: Acer Re-enters XR with New AR & Smart Glasses
VR.summary: Acer has re-entered the XR market with the launch of two new AR and smart glasses after a seven-year hiatus.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is being offered at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play event, which runs until June 10.

VR.title: Beat Saber Drops Three Free New Songs For Its Eight Year Anniversary
VR.summary: Beat Saber celebrates its 8th anniversary by releasing three new free songs, enhancing its popular rhythm game experience.

AI.title: Microsoft’s first advanced reasoning AI is here
AI.summary: Microsoft unveiled its advanced reasoning AI model, MAI-Thinking-1, at Build 2026, marking a significant step in its AI development.

AI.summary: Microsoft announced Project Solara, a new operating system designed specifically for gadgets running AI agents, at its Build 2026 conference.

AI.title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
AI.summary: Google's Phone app will now flag calls from scammers impersonating contacts, enhancing user protection against AI-driven fraud.

AI.summary: Microsoft introduced Scout, an AI personal assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 apps, aimed at improving productivity for businesses.

AI.title: Gemini’s new AI agent is about as good as Google’s demo
AI.summary: Google's new AI agent, Gemini Spark, is designed to efficiently handle tasks on behalf of users, showcasing advanced capabilities.

AI.summary: Google published exploit code for a critical vulnerability affecting millions of Chromium users, raising security concerns.

NFL.title: Eagles sign RB Elijah Mitchell

NFL.title: Seahawks, Derick Hall agree to three-year contract extension
NFL.summary: The Seahawks have secured a three-year contract extension for key defensive player Derick Hall, solidifying their roster.

NFL.title: Commanders sign TE Anthony Firkser
NFL.summary: Veteran tight end Anthony Firkser has signed with the Washington Commanders, adding depth to their tight end position.

NFL.title: Colts get all of their draft class under contract
NFL.summary: The Indianapolis Colts have successfully signed all members of their draft class to contracts ahead of the upcoming season.

NFL.title: Vic Fangio wins 2026 Dr. Z Award for lifetime achievement
NFL.summary: Vic Fangio has been awarded the 2026 Dr. Z Award for lifetime achievement by the Pro Football Writers of America.

NFL.title: The Myles Garrett trade has caused Aaron Donald to consider a comeback
NFL.summary: Aaron Donald is considering a comeback following the trade of Myles Garrett, which has reignited his competitive spirit.
